data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Holub total 22, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.

in_hebrew.name: Holub
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Bright, Shining One
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Holub הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Slavic word ‘holuby’, meaning ‘little dove’. In Christian symbolism, the dove is a symbol of the Holy Spirit.

in_greek.name: Holub
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Bright, Shining One
in_greek.long_meaning: Holub είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Slavic word ‘holuby’, meaning ‘little dove’. In Christian symbolism, the dove is a symbol of the Holy Spirit.

in_latin.name: Holub
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Bright, Shining One
in_latin.long_meaning: Holub est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Slavic word ‘holuby’, meaning ‘little dove’. In Christian symbolism, the dove is a symbol of the Holy Spirit.
